import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import sys
import time
import unittest

root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
expected = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
output = Path(sys.argv[3])
import crewshal
from crewshal.dispatch import SOURCE_FILES
actual = Path(crewshal.__file__).resolve().parent
if actual != expected:
    raise ValueError(f"Wrong package: {actual}; expected {expected}")
identities = {}
for path in sorted(actual.iterdir()):
    if path.suffix in {".py", ".c"}:
        data = path.read_bytes()
        identities[path.name] = {"bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
source = root / "src" / "crewshal"
for name, identity in identities.items():
    raw = (source/name).read_bytes()
    if {"bytes":len(raw), "sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()} != identity:
        raise ValueError(f"Packaged source differs: {name}")
sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover(str(root / "tests"), top_level_dir=str(root))
def cases(item):
    if isinstance(item, unittest.TestSuite):
        for nested in item:
            yield from cases(nested)
    else:
        yield item
ids = [item.id() for item in cases(suite)]
if len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
    raise ValueError("Duplicate test IDs; discovery is not an independent count")
phase = sum(".test_phase_2d" in item for item in ids)
start = time.monotonic()
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=1).run(suite)
report = {"tests":result.testsRun, "phase_2d_methods":phase, "failures":len(result.failures),
          "errors":len(result.errors), "skipped":len(result.skipped), "seconds":time.monotonic()-start,
          "test_ids_sha256":hashlib.sha256("\n".join(ids).encode()).hexdigest(),
          "package":str(actual), "version":crewshal.__version__, "packaged_sources":identities,
          "dispatch_bound_sources":len(SOURCE_FILES), "dispatch_source_sha256":{name:hashlib.sha256((actual/Path(name).name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in SOURCE_FILES},
          "python":platform.python_version(), "system":platform.system(), "machine":platform.machine(),
          "network":"OS denied", "environment":"empty; distinct fresh HOME"}
output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k not in {"packaged_sources"}},sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1)
